license: NO_NEW_SOFTWARE_LICENSE_SELECTED; limited explicit owner transfer authorization
review_scope: Source history and necessary snippets reviewed; no bundled external JS libraries or third-party headers identified in these snippets; no universal originality warranty

hash_conventions.source_blob: Git SHA-1 object ID at source_commit; includes Git blob framing.
hash_conventions.source_git_blob_sha256: SHA-256 of raw Git blob content, UTF-8 LF; excludes Git object framing.
hash_conventions.source_checkout_sha256: SHA-256 of independently checked local source file bytes, currently UTF-8 CRLF; separate from the Git blob hash.
hash_conventions.spans: One-based inclusive reviewed declaration/source line spans; UTF-8 bytes with the terminal line ending excluded. These are explicit formatting spans, not AST ranges. Source spans use Git LF; destination spans retain current checkout line endings and also provide LF-normalized hashes.
hash_conventions.byte_reuse: Only exact same-name single declarations with byte-identical complete recorded spans; never renamed or composed mappings. Span labels do not imply an AST parser.
hash_conventions.destination_sha256: SHA-256 of complete current destination checkout bytes. destination_lf_normalized_sha256 separately makes newline conversion explicit.

exclusions: historical C2/v5 manifests and frozen P03 bytes
